decisive_items: a remote bronchoscopic resection of a tracheal carcinoid 17 years earlier
a carcinoid tumor was initially suspected
large nests of eosinophilic cells within a collagenous and myxoid matrix
response.rationale: History of prior tracheal carcinoid and current histologic suspicion directly support recurrent tracheal carcinoid; R1 is a broader neuroendocrine category, less specific.

rejected.why: Neuroendocrine tumor is a broader umbrella; carcinoid is the specific diagnosis evident from history and initial histologic impression.
